correctness.rationale: The state-to-flat-spectrum identity is derived by character orthogonality. The complete 2510-cut Smith diagonal table is obtained from exact integer gcds of every nontrivial minor using a standalone exhaustive standard-library verifier built from golden-ratio coordinates. An independent graph construction computes all 2510 cut ranks for 48 primes up through 223, with the Hadamard bound excluding any additional exceptional primes. Each binomial total and the twelve pentagon-plus-antipode exceptional sets are checked. Exact scripts were executed, with no probabilistic or infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The ordinary icosahedron is a canonical maximally symmetric finite quantum network and the entropy across a spatial partition is a natural stabilizer-resource invariant. The exact exhaustive classification provides an independently reproducible all-cut benchmark for every prime dimension and isolates a geometric fivefold obstruction: twelve pentagonal six-cuts lose one entanglement unit only in characteristic five, with an unrelated characteristic-two mechanism. The precise number of exceptional cuts, their structure and modular dependence are not determined by an already available binary rank table; finite but naturally complete classification is mathematically substantive.
